note: The script asks for the hook text, one name super, a key-words stack, a number pop and one top text line, so 5 graphics and the end card. The CASS logo file is not in endcards/ yet, so the end card types CASS until it is added.

mg.title: Hook text

text.main: I just really started seeing people.

mg.cue: Hook text on frame 1: I just really started seeing people. Already on screen at 0:00. Does not animate on.
mg.use: Start the clip at frame 0045 (fully on) and hold it until 00:03. Top third.

mg.title: Name super
mg.cue: Name super at 00:04 for 3 s, lower left above the captions: Nicole Peña / Chief Development Officer, CASS.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:04 for 3 s. Move it lower left, above the captions. Type the second line Chief Development Officer, CASS under the name.

mg.title: Key words
mg.cue: Key words at 00:15, stacked in the top band as she says them: a case manager / into housing / fresh pair of sheets.
mg.use: Start at 00:15 so each phrase lands as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: Number pop

text.label: people are housed under CASS's roof

mg.cue: Number pop at 00:36 for 3 s, top band, as she says it: 830 / people are housed under CASS's roof.
mg.use: Start at 00:36 so the number lands on <830>. Top band.

mg.title: Top text
mg.cue: Top text at 00:51 for 2.5 s, top band, as she says it: Welcome to the family.
mg.use: Put it on at 00:51 as she says it. Top band. Keep captions on.

mg.title: End card
mg.cue: End card: CASS logo, then the line For more information visit cassaz.org.
mg.src: No CASS end card or logo file is in the repo yet (endcards/index.json has no CASS entry, checked 3 Nov 2026), so CASS is typed. Line from the script's end card row (cassaz.org, the CASS end card line in the client file); colours from the CASS brand (navy #2C2B77, white).
mg.use: After the last line at 00:56. Hold it to the end. Swap in the CASS logo once it is in the repo.
